THE DECISION WE WANT TO MAKE

“Did the edit cross
the agreed boundary?”

01 / BEFORE REUSE

Agree on meaning.

Creator and brand define allowed channels, editing limits, attribution and duration. Both accept identical terms.

02 / WHEN AN EDIT IS DISPUTED

Compare the evidence.

Preserve the original, the edited use and the surrounding context. Missing or inaccessible evidence must stop a verdict.

03 / PROPOSED NETWORK FLOW

Reach a shared decision.

GenLayer validators evaluate the evidence against the agreement. A finalized result would update the case’s approval state.

WHY THIS DIRECTION

Permission is more
than a payment split.

Our focus is the meaning of sponsor edits: removed warnings, new implied endorsements and changes in context.

Closest public project

RoyaltyCircuit

Its published workflow centers on rights splits and usage-statement reconciliation. ContextSeal focuses on whether an edit preserves the message under creator-approved rules.
